content.short: Cardano Visualisation presents Cardano network structure and activity through an interface designed for intuitive exploration.
content.description: Cardano Visualisation is built to help users understand the Cardano network through visual exploration rather than raw data tables alone. The project focuses on making network structure and activity easier to grasp at a glance, turning blockchain behavior into something more intuitive for researchers, community members, and curious users. Its value comes from presentation: helping people see how Cardano moves and connects in practice.
